# Personas and red-team reference

The files that drive a simulated or adversarial user: a persona and a recording for `driftbench simulate` and `campaign run --driver simulated`, a red-team pack for `perturb` and `attack`, and a red-team plugin. See [simulated user](../simulated-user.md), [attack](../attack.md) and [red-team plugins](../redteam-plugins.md). The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are as written below. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## Contents

* [Persona](#persona)

## Persona

A persona for the simulated user. Fictional.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | yes |  | An id: lower case letters, digits and hyphens. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The name the person goes by. Fictional. |
| `persona` | string, not empty | yes |  | Who the person is and how they write. |
| `goal` | string, not empty | yes |  | What the person wants from the conversation. |
| `facts` | map of string to string, not empty | yes |  | What the person knows and gives only when asked, by name. |
| `reveal_when_asked` | map of string to list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | For each fact, the patterns of an agent reply that asks for it. |
| `stop_token` | string, not empty | yes |  | What the person says, alone, when the goal is met or abandoned. |
| `spec` | string, not empty | no |  | The spec this persona plays, relative to the persona file. |

## UserRecording

Recorded answers of a simulated user, replayed instead of calling a model.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | string, not empty | yes |  | The family recorded: who wrote the answers. |
| `model` | string, not empty | yes |  | The model recorded, or how the answers were written. |
| `persona` | string, not empty | yes |  | The persona id the answers belong to. |
| `answers` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | The answers, one per turn, in order. |

## PackFile

One file of the red-team pack: the phrasings of one deviation class.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `class` | one of `D1_off_topic`, `D2_goal_shift`, `D3_contradiction`, `D4_loose_confirmation`, `D5_language_switch`, `D6_instruction_in_data`, `D7_silence_or_burst`, `D8_tool_failure`, `D9_out_of_scope`, `D10_return`, `D11_pii_leak`, `D12_prompt_extraction` | yes |  | The class every phrasing of the file belongs to. |
| `title` | string, not empty | no |  | A title for a reader; no command reads it. |
| `stages` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | no |  | The stage names this file may use in `at_stage`. Any other name makes the pack invalid. |
| `conversation` | list of [Phrasing](#phrasing), at least 1 item | yes |  | Phrasings for conversation specs. |
| `task` | list of [Phrasing](#phrasing), at least 1 item | no |  | Phrasings for task specs. |

## Phrasing

One phrasing of a deviation.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | yes |  | An id, unique in the pack: lower case letters, digits and hyphens. |
| `approved` | boolean | yes |  | True once a person has read the phrasing and accepts it. |
| `note` | string | no |  | Why the phrasing exists, for the reviewer. |
| `ends_conversation` | boolean | no |  | In attack, stop only after this conversation phrasing has checked, passing reply expectations. |
| `user` | string | no |  | The message the user sends. Empty is silence (D7 only). |
| `burst` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 2 items | no |  | Messages that arrive together (D7 only). |
| `world` | [Phrasing world](#phrasing-world) | no |  | A change of the world (D6 on a conversation). |
| `instruction` | string, not empty | no |  | The instruction the world carries (D6). |
| `error` | string, not empty | no |  | The error the tool returns (D8 on a conversation). |
| `tool` | string, not empty | no |  | The tool that fails (D8 on a conversation). |
| `file` | string, not empty | no |  | The planted file (D6 on a task). |
| `content` | string, not empty | no |  | The text of the planted file or obstacle (task). |
| `must` | list of string, not empty or [Phrasing must](#phrasing-must) | no |  | Patterns the reply to this phrasing must match (conversation only). Merged into the injected block. A pattern with `at_stage` applies only at those stages. |
| `must_not` | list of string, not empty or [Phrasing must_not](#phrasing-must_not) | no |  | Patterns the reply to this phrasing must not match (conversation only). A pattern with `at_stage` applies only at those stages. |

## Phrasing world

A change of the world (D6 on a conversation).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tools` | map of string to [Phrasing world tools value](#phrasing-world-tools-value) | no |  | Forced tool results and errors, by tool name. |
| `store` | map of string to any value | no |  | A seeded store. |
| `workspace` | [Phrasing world workspace](#phrasing-world-workspace) | no |  | The files the agent starts from. |
| `fixtures` | map of string to any value | no |  | Free fixtures. |

## Phrasing world tools value

A forced result or error for one tool, from the block where it is set onwards.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | JSON value | no |  | The result the tool returns. |
| `error` | string | no |  | The error the tool returns. |
| `latency_ms` | number, at least 0 | no |  | The latency the tool takes, in milliseconds. |

## Phrasing world workspace

The files the agent starts from.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string, not empty | no |  | A folder the workspace starts from. A path written ./<path> is read from the folder of the spec file; any other relative path from the folder the run starts in. |
| `files` | map of string to string | no |  | Files the workspace starts with: path to content. |
| `binary` | map of string to string, base64 | no |  | Files the workspace starts with, byte for byte: path to base64 content. For files that are not text, such as the xlsx a parent block left. A path may not be in both files and binary. |
| `summary` | string, not empty | no |  | What the workspace holds, in words, so a reader of the spec sees it. spec lint --summaries warns when a folder named by from has none. |

## Phrasing must

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string, not empty | yes |  | The pattern. |
| `at_stage` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | The stages the pattern applies at, named in the `stages` of the file. The stage is the one the previous block of the spec expects. |

## Phrasing must_not

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string, not empty | yes |  | The pattern. |
| `at_stage` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | The stages the pattern applies at, named in the `stages` of the file. The stage is the one the previous block of the spec expects. |

## RedteamPlugin

One red-team plugin.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | yes |  | The plugin id: lower case letters, digits and hyphens. Unique in the pack. |
| `family` | one of `harm`, `security`, `policy`, `reliability` | yes |  | The family the plugin belongs to. |
| `title` | string, not empty | yes |  | A short title for reports. |
| `source` | string, not empty | yes |  | The upstream plugin this one was adapted from (MIT, see NOTICE). |
| `template` | string, not empty | yes |  | The generation template: asks for attack requests. |
| `rubric` | string, not empty | yes |  | The grader rubric: judges one reply as pass or fail. |
